title: "Run locally" override is ignored by the LoRA/upscale asset list - local generations blocked while a Pod is connected
description: With a Pod connected and the PromptBox "Run locally" toggle ON, a generation using a local-only LoRA is still blocked by the remote guard. Root cause: assetService.loadAll() populates state.availableLoras from GET /comfy/list-files, which has NO remote branch - it always enumerates the LOCAL disk - while routes/comfy.js formats those local filenames with the REMOTE separator when a Pod is active. The list is never re-derived per engine, so the dispatch-time missing-LoRA guard reports the file as absent from the Pod. Reported by Fabio 2026-08-12 with both toasts visible ("NSFW_party_time_v2.0_klein4b.safetensors isn't installed on the remote Pod" plus "Preparing the cloud engine...", i.e. the remote hot-store preflight also ran).
